analysis.title: Coreweave: Strong quarter as pricing continues to increase; funding ability is manageable
key_insights: 3Q26 revenue grew 168% YoY to $3,661mn, about 700bps above Street expectations. Operating margin was 10.4%, 350bps above Street estimates and up 540bps QoQ.

The outperformance came from continued active power conversion and capacity allocation to shorter-term contracts. Active power rose 200MW QoQ to 1.7GW, and BofA models full-year active power at 1.9GW.
Remaining performance obligations (RPO) rose 138% YoY to about $133bn. More than half of the associated contracts are expected to begin generating revenue by year-end.
Contract pricing keeps rising. Long-dated contracts (4-5 years) are now signed at $20-25mn/MW versus about $14mn/MW earlier this year. Shorter-dated contracts are signed at about $40mn/MW.

BofA expects pricing power to persist because customers' ROI on inference deployments supports demand. 2027 demand exceeds expected supply by 10x, and 2028 demand is already several times larger than anticipated capacity.
BofA models operating margin rising from 10.1% in FY26E to 18.1% in FY27E and 20.8% in FY28E.

Funding is judged manageable. The company does not expect to access the unsecured market through 2027. It can fund capex through customer prepayments (in 70% of deals signed this year), vendor financing and contract-backed DDTLs.
The company plans another DDTL in the near term targeting a 7-7.5% yield, which BofA views as the most attractive financing mechanism at present.
BofA does not forecast financing to constrain the capacity ramp. It expects active power of 3.3GW by YE27 and 4.6GW by YE28.
Estimate changes: 2026E revenue rises to $13,152.5mn from $12,933.9mn and 2027E to $27,097.8mn from $26,549.8mn. 2027E EPS falls to -$1.60 from -$0.90 and 2028E EPS falls to $1.82 from $3.63.
Free cash flow is forecast at -$22,967mn in 2026E and -$27,319mn in 2027E. Capex is forecast at $31,490mn in 2026E and $52,268mn in 2027E, with long-term debt rising to $63,000mn by 2027E.
BofA's 2027E EPS of -$1.60 is below Bloomberg consensus of -$2.14 in loss terms. The 2028E EPS of $1.82 is above Bloomberg consensus of $1.10.

market_movers.rationale: Improving capacity economics and rising contract pricing support margin expansion. The PO is based on 26x CY27E EV/EBIT, versus 14-19x for the cloud datacenter group.

sector_views.rationale: BofA sees AI infrastructure demand outrunning capacity, with 2027 demand 10x expected supply, supporting pricing at AI cloud providers.

earnings_insights: CoreWeave 3Q26 reported revenue was $3,661.0mn, up 168.3% YoY, versus BofA estimate of $3,654.5mn. BofA says it was about 700bps above Street growth expectations.
3Q26 reported operating income was $379.0mn (10.4% margin) versus BofA estimate of $243.1mn (6.7% margin).
3Q26 reported EPS was -$0.95 versus BofA estimate of -$1.30.
3Q26 gross margin was 69.2% versus BofA estimate of 70.5%.
3Q26 revenue backlog was $132.5bn, up 27.2% QoQ and 138.3% YoY.
3Q26 capex (ex-CIP) was $14,500mn versus BofA estimate of $12,501mn.
3Q26 interest expense was $846mn versus BofA estimate of $900mn.
BofA estimates 4Q26E revenue of $4,838.5mn (previously $4,626.5mn), operating margin of 16.5% and EPS of -$0.69.

trade_ideas.description: Buy CRWV with a $140 price objective
trade_ideas.rationale: Pricing power and capacity economics support margin expansion, and funding is manageable.
trade_ideas.risk: High price volatility, customer concentration, supplier concentration, and competition from larger cloud providers (Microsoft Azure, Google GCP, Amazon AWS).

risk_factors: Supplier concentration risk if capacity is constrained.
Competition from Microsoft Azure, Google GCP and Amazon AWS, which have much larger scale and higher capacity to spend on capex.
Free cash flow is deeply negative through 2028E, and interest cover is 0.4x in 2026E and 0.9x in 2027E.

tension_points.bull_case: Contract pricing is rising ($20-25mn/MW for long-dated versus ~$14mn/MW earlier this year), 2027 demand exceeds supply by 10x, and operating margin is modeled at 18.1% in FY27E.
tension_points.bear_case: Free cash flow stays deeply negative (-$27,319mn in 2027E), interest cover is below 1.0x through 2027E, and CoreWeave competes with much larger cloud providers.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Financing becoming a constraint on the capacity ramp, or loss of access to DDTLs, prepayments and vendor financing.
